verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI's document_annotation returns a structured annotation of the whole document based on a user-provided annotation format, and bbox_annotation does the same for extracted figures and charts. The docs list concrete field-extraction use cases such as invoice vendors and amounts, receipt merchants and totals, and contract clauses, so the core of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the format is a JSON schema, any description of schema validation or conformance guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of schema-driven extraction.
